answer: Cosignatures are collected in saffron, verified in juniper, and walnut names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 26 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 215 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
